name: Dovetail
description: Connect your customer intelligence to Claude and put real customer data behind every answer.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dovetail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dovetail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dovetail.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dovetail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dovetail provides these MCP tools: get_project_highlights, get_project_insight, get_insight_content, list_project_insights, get_data_content, get_project_data, list_project_data, get_dovetail_projects, and search_workspace.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dovetail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dovetail in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Dovetail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dovetail is developed by Dovetail. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
